You enjoy simplifying complex environments, moving solutions toward standard, supportable configurations, and sharing what you know so that no critical knowledge sits with one person.  You bring strong ServiceNow experience, a solid understanding of IT service management practices such as ITIL, and the communication skills to work with business users, technical teams and vendors. What you?ll get to do Reporting to the Manager, Service and Database Management, this role is the technical lead for BC Assessment?s ServiceNow IT Service Management platform across its Development, Test and Production instances.
